scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the remaining GitHub batch-progress original. Existing frozen-task outcomes remain separate and unchanged.
linked_reference_caveat: This read covers only the original. It does not newly read linked language notes, verification cases, executable probes or cross-language verifier. Prior experiment evidence is not repeated or promoted to broader liveness claims.

sources.workflow: Preserve an actual batch script's processing and caller contract while adding durable start, progress, failure and final-summary reporting on a compatible separate channel, with correct terminal-outcome counts and verified runtime visibility.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual script, callers, existing runtime and nearby tests, result streams, error and cancellation policy and output contract are required. Linked language-specific notes and verification cases need review for the chosen runtime. Cross-language probe execution needs all named runtimes; a Python-only selected task does not inherently require the others or an external service.
sources.offline_assessment: A real public batch-script modification can be offline with harmless public inputs and independent replay. The standard-library Python default fits suitably selected Python changes. Captured-after-exit logs cannot establish live visibility, and simulated cancellation cannot certify actual host termination or signal behavior. No bundled source probe was executed in this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently verify unchanged stdout and processing policy, actual exit status, monotonic counters, exact terminal accounting and summaries for applicable empty, unknown-total, partial and fail-fast paths. A liveness claim requires reading actual child output before child exit with a safe deterministic gate; watchdogs must fail rather than manufacture success. Keep original narrower measured outcomes separate from unmeasured liveness and real-signal cancellation.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
